Should import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.JsonNodeFactory. Also need imports for assertThrows, assertNotNull, etc from org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions. Also need to fix DummyValidationContext extends ValidationContext; need to import ValidationContext etc already imported.

The bigger issue: In test class they defined fields schemaPath, uri, schemaNode, parentSchema, someFlag as if they were part of JsonSchema, but they are not defined in test class. The errors about someFlag, uri, etc in equals method: they refer to those fields in JsonSchema class, but they are not accessible. Actually they wrote equals overriding from JsonSchema? They wrote @Override public boolean equals(Object o) ... but the test class does not extend JsonSchema, so cannot override equals of JsonSchema. Should not have those methods. The test class should not implement equals/hashCode. Remove those overrides.

Also createChildSchema method inside test class is not needed; they should call jsonSchema.createChildSchema (the method from JsonSchema). Actually JsonSchema already has a public method createChildSchema. So the test class's createChildSchema method is redundant and causing type mismatch because 'this' is test class, not JsonSchema. Remove that method.
